title: Instance properties panel doesn't fill the Properties pane width (MC instance selected)
description:
RESOLVED. InstancePanel root was capped at a fixed width:200px (+flexShrink:0), so when the Properties pane was wider (measured 240px) the Instance section stopped ~40px short of the edge while sibling Transform/Align panels (no fixed width) filled.

ROOT CAUSE: packages/authoring-ui/src/InstancePanel.tsx styles.panel hardcoded width:'200px' + flexShrink:0. Mounted inside <PanelGroup title='Instance'> whose content wrapper is a full-width block div; the fixed 200px overrode the available pane width. TransformPanel.tsx styles.panel sets NO width (just flexShrink:0), which is why it filled — confirmed firsthand by reading both style blocks. git blame: width:200px present since file creation (4b4e4cf); not a re-theme regression (1248 only touched colors). Matches the filed diagnosis.

FIX: InstancePanel.tsx styles.panel — removed width:'200px' + flexShrink:0; set width:'100%' + boxSizing:'border-box' so the panel stretches to the PanelGroup content wrapper / pane width like the sibling panels. Internal layout already uses flex:1 inputs/selects + fixed-width labels (flexShrink:0), so widening the root lets the inputs grow to fill the wider pane. 1-file, 8-line CSS-only change.

NO REGRESSION to task 1280 (mobile/narrow responsive) or other panels: that behavior lives in Shell pane sizing, not InstancePanel internals; removing a fixed cap only makes the panel adapt to whatever width the pane provides. rightPaneResponsive.test.ts (9, the 1280 suite) and propertiesPanelGroup.test.ts (7) both pass.

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build -> all 7 packages Done (green), incl authoring-ui tsc.
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run -> 57 files / 771 tests PASSED, 0 failed.
- No task-1207 fixture failures in authoring-ui (those live in another package).
- Playwright computed-width re-measure DEFERRED: no dev server up and the /__agent WS bridge is a singleton with concurrent agents (1290) active; the change is deterministic CSS mirroring the sibling TransformPanel that already fills (width:100% on a flex-column child of a full-width block wrapper). The repo's UI unit tests are pure-logic (no DOM render harness), so a render-based width assertion would require a new dev dep, out of scope.
